weather.blurb: Triple digits again. Water bottle, shade, and an early start.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 3 · Grass 3 · Weed 4 · Ragweed, Elm, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Ragweed and elm and grasses are heavy today. Windows closed, meds early.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 85,200 megawatts, with 113,000 on hand.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 12 hours and 15 minutes today, and down by 7:32 p.m.
